title: Primary coil voltage
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the voltage across the primary coil as 110 V.

title: Maximum flux change rate
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum rate of change of magnetic flux as 0.5√2 Wb/s.

title: Transformer voltage ratio
description: Important: Applies the transformer turns ratio correctly to relate primary and secondary voltages.

title: Series circuit analysis
description: Important: Correctly analyzes the series circuit to determine the normal operating voltage of a single bulb.

title: Faraday's law application
description: Important: Applies Faraday's law (U = n·ΔΦ/Δt) to relate voltage to rate of flux change.

title: RMS vs. peak voltage
description: Important: Correctly distinguishes between RMS and peak voltage values from the given waveform.

title: Incorrect turns ratio
description: Pitfall: Uses current ratio instead of voltage ratio for transformer analysis.

title: Wrong bulb voltage
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assumes bulb voltage is 220 V or fails to account for series connection.

title: Peak vs. RMS confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses RMS voltage where peak voltage is required in Faraday's law calculation.
